notes.title: Third game in There's Always a Madman series now available for purchase
notes.notes: [p]The third game in the [b][i]There's Always a Madman[/i][/b] series has just released!  In the interactive spy novel [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3282050/Theres_Always_a_Madman_Bring_the_Thunder"]There's Always a Madman: Bring the Thunder[/url], a madman named Zeus seeks to build a weather machine and rain down destruction upon the world.  Well, we can't have that - it's a good thing you always bring the thunder, agent![/p][p][/p][p]Although each game in the [b][i]There's Always a Madman[/i][/b] series is a standalone adventure for secret agents Franklin Benjamin and Virginia West, all three released games are on discount right now for the [b]Steam Summer Sale.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b][i][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2390500/Theres_Always_a_Madman_Fight_or_Flight" style="button"]There's Always a Madman: Fight or Flight[/url][/i][/b][/p][p][/p][p][b][i][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2960890/Theres_Always_a_Madman_Do_Your_Worst" style="button"]There's Always a Madman: Do Your Worst[/url][/i][/b][/p][p][/p][p][b][i][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3282050/Theres_Always_a_Madman_Bring_the_Thunder" style="button"]There's Always a Madman: Bring the Thunder[/url][/i][/b][/p][p][/p][p]With the release of the third entry, now is the best time to catch up on the entire series (with all three released games currently on discount).  And the fourth and fifth entries are available to wishlist on Steam now as well![/p][p][/p][p][b][i][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3372850/Theres_Always_a_Madman_The_MacGuffin" style="button"]There's Always a Madman: The MacGuffin[/url][/i][/b][/p][p][/p][p][b][i][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3373580/Theres_Always_a_Madman_VICTOR" style="button"]There's Always a Madman: V.I.C.T.O.R.[/url][/i][/b][/p][p][/p][p]Best of luck agent - [b]because there's always a madman, and you're the best agent we've got![/b][/p]

notes.title: Release date announced as part of Spy Video Game Rendezvous festival
notes.notes:
Going on now - the first-ever Steam festival (and accompanying Direct) for spy video games, the [b]Spy Video Game Rendezvous[/b], includes all the games in the [b]There's Always a Madman[/b] series.
[list]
[*] Spy Video Game Rendezvous Direct: [url=https://youtu.be/OmzdWLCbzpE]https://youtu.be/OmzdWLCbzpE[/url]
[*] Spy Video Game Rendezvous Festival: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45263338/sale/SpyVideoGameRendezvous]https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45263338/sale/SpyVideoGameRendezvous[/url]
[/list]
Each of the two released games in the [b]There's Always a Madman[/b] series are on discount for the festival:
[list]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2390500/Theres_Always_a_Madman_Fight_or_Flight]There's Always a Madman: Fight or Flight[/url]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2960890/Theres_Always_a_Madman_Do_Your_Worst]There's Always a Madman: Do Your Worst[/url]
[/list]
[b]Also announced as part of the festival:[/b] the third entry in the series, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3282050/Theres_Always_a_Madman_Bring_the_Thunder]There's Always a Madman: Bring the Thunder[/url], will be releasing July 7th 2025[b][/b].  That's right - Agent 707 returns on 7/7, and there's a [b]free demo for the game you can play right now[/b] ahead of the June Steam Next Fest.

As you can see, there's no better time to see if you have the secret agent skills necessary to save the world with two games on discount and another right around the corner (with a free demo of the third game that you can play now).  [b]Because there's always a madman, and you're the best agent we've got![/b]
